historical_evidence_correction: The original 496a630 implementation did not reject duplicate JSON keys or repeated consumption, and accepted bool/float protocol values. The original negative-contract claims below were therefore overstated at 79ed227. Opus B1/B2/B3 were reproduced with 22 failing cases before repair e155317. The repair evidence distinguishes those observed failures from additional regressions that already passed; these original foundation run records are retained as history, not proof of the missing controls.
implemented: Frozen NativeTerminalReport with exact private field allowlist and closed runner, execution/profile, problem and protocol values.
NativeReportBinding binds run, nonce, attempt, runner, execution mode, profile and a generated single-component basename before launch.
Allocation uses validated domain/checkouts/<checkout_id>/reports private directories and refuses any pre-existing target without overwriting it.
Consumption uses validate_private_file plus bounded shared read_regular(limit+1), strict UTF-8/JSON shape/depth/type/identity/exit/completeness checks and fixed typed errors.
Cleanup records the consumed inode and does not unlink a replacement, symlink, hard link, foreign or otherwise unsafe target.
No public JSON schema, CLI, scheduler, operations lifecycle, adapter launch, bridge or dependency behavior changed.

negative_contracts.state: After repair e155317, duplicate-key contradictions cannot overwrite refusal/failure into a pass; a successfully consumed binding retains its first device/inode for cleanup and rejects subsequent consumes, including after cleanup. Invalid first reads preserve the target and permit later correction. Foreign-owner and concurrent replacement probes remain unverified.
negative_contracts.exposure: Record fields are an exact allowlist; argv, env, paths, filenames, coverage, test IDs and arbitrary text never enter NativeTerminalReport; error messages are fixed.
negative_contracts.availability: Report bytes, runtime-version length, exit range, attempts and report basename are finite; read_regular reads at most the single bounded limit+1 path.
negative_contracts.dependencies: Symlink, FIFO, directory and hard-linked targets are rejected by shared private-file/no-follow validation; parent directories are created only through ensure_private_dir and report writes remain exclusive caller-owned operations.
